title: Early drummers and the Jimmy Noon band lineup
summary: He names early drummers and recalls John Vean drumming with Jimmy Noon and Peter Bocage, plus the guitar-versus-banjo question.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players

Oh, well, the ones I know, Henry Zeno, Ernestopano, John Veen, Arnold Piers, Ray Happi. And, uh, what do you call this player there? Good drummers.
Who did these guys play with, the different ones you mentioned?
Well, all the trumpet players had their own bands, you know?
